definitions: A condition on road networks that occurs as use increases, and is characterized by slower speeds, longer trip times, and increased vehicular queuing.
A situation in which there are too many vehicles on the road at one time, causing slow movement or complete stops.
examples: Commuters often face severe traffic congestion during peak hours.
New road construction aims to alleviate traffic congestion in the city center.
Traffic congestion is a major problem in many urban areas worldwide.
